limits: Touch PointerEvent sequences remain synthetic and bypass capture only in the test harness; native mouse checks exercise production capture.
Native multi-finger touchscreen arbitration, physical Android/iOS, and Safari were not validated.
Cloned busy/failure/Retry notices validate layout and hit targets, not native palette failure recovery; real Copy validates the actual transient feedback path.
Clip-wide refinement can retain Fit-level detail for long animations; existing Fit/source/short-axis allocations are not a whole-app memory bound.
